hero.heading: Connect, Secure, & Engage: 3 Powerful Ways to Deliver Digital Documents via Email
hero.body: Reach your customers directly in their inbox, improve customer experience, and drastically reduce your postage and paper costs with Renkim's tailored email solutions.

facts.heading: The Benefit
facts.body: Deliver your message effortlessly. Templates can include embedded document images for instant visibility and increased engagement.

facts.heading: How It Works
facts.body: Sends customized text-based or HTML templates straight to your customer's inbox without requiring an upfront authentication or login page.

facts.heading: The Benefit
facts.body: Maximum security. Because the documents are fully interactive, you can glide your customers directly to your payment portal.

facts.heading: How It Works
facts.body: Sends a link directing your customer to a secure authentication page on Renkim web servers. After entering their information, they are seamlessly guided to an interactive PDF or HTML version of the document via a Personalized URL (PURL).

facts.heading: The Approach
facts.body: The perfect blend of security and convenience.

facts.heading: The Benefit
facts.body: By utilizing password protection on the PDF, you seamlessly combine the ironclad security of an eNotice with the effortless convenience of an eBlast.

facts.heading: How It Works
facts.body: Delivers a statement or critical document as a direct email attachment without requiring your customer to log into an external portal.
